import Lean

/-!
Planted by the trust self-test, plant V2-E4: `@[implemented_by]` data attached
through the attribute API, so that no source token spells the attribute. Only
the environment pass of the gate can see it.
-/

def plantedImplementation : Nat := 1

def plantedImplementedTarget : Nat := 0

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftCoreM do
  match Lean.Compiler.implementedByAttr.setParam (← Lean.getEnv) `plantedImplementedTarget
      `plantedImplementation with
  | .ok environment => Lean.setEnv environment
  | .error message => throwError message
